subject: Proposal: 2-year smoothed prepay + credit-buffer model
messages:
From: Asha Raman <asha.r@lumenix.com>
To: olga.petrov@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@lumenix.com
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Structuring multi-year prepay with smoothing credits

Hi Olga,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at Lumenix is excited about Redwood's latency and cost profile. Procurement asked me to follow up on the commercial structure: we have budget covering an initial 24-month commitment but would like payments smoothed and a credit buffer for year-2 variability.

High-level ask: can Redwood provide a 2-year prepaid quote with an effective discount schedule (year-1 / year-2), an optional mid-term ramp adjustment (to account for usage growth), and a small on-account credit buffer that can be drawn against overage in the second year? We prefer a simple amortized payment schedule rather than lump-sum year 1 only.

Attached is our expected usage profile for the next 24 months. Can you share an illustrative pricing table and any standard approval lead times for multi-year prepay discounts? We are hoping to finalize commercial terms before Thanksgiving.

Thanks,
Asha Raman
Head of Platform Partnerships
Lumenix Inc
[Attachment: Lumenix_usage_profile_24m.csv (csv)]

From: olga.petrov@redwood.com
To: Asha Raman <asha.r@lumenix.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.com, rafael.mendes@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Structuring multi-year prepay with smoothing credits

Hi Asha — great to hear. I took a look at the usage profile and attached an initial proposal that expresses: (1) an amortized 24-month payment schedule, (2) a nominal year-2 credit buffer (3% of committed spend) that can be consumed against overages, and (3) an optional ramp true-up at month 12 with a one-way upward adjustment.

High-level numbers (illustrative):
- List price: $0.015/token (baseline)
- 2-yr prepay discount: 16% effective across the 24 months when smoothed monthly
- If Lumenix chooses a mid-term ramp, we allow a one-time true-up at month 12 with an incremental 8% discount on the additional committed volume beyond the original forecast
- Credit buffer: 3% of committed ARR usable in year 2 for overage protection (expires at contract end)

I flagged this with Ben and Rafael for approval on the discount math and any non-standard commercial language. See attached workbook for the amortization schedule and an example invoice cadence.

Next steps: if these numbers look directionally right, we'll route for internal pricing approval and return a redline-ready term sheet + DocuSign link.

Thanks — Olga
Olga Petrov
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: term_summary_redwood_v2.pdf (pdf); Lumenix_prepay_workbook_v3.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: ben.carter@redwood.com
To: rafael.mendes@redwood.com, neha.kapoor@redwood.com, olga.petrov@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 14:18:00 -0800
Subject: Internal: approval check — Lumenix 2yr smoothed prepay

Team — quick internal thread to confirm approval levels. Context from Olga: 2yr smoothed prepay, 16% effective discount if amortized, 3% credit buffer for year 2, optional month-12 true-up (8% on incremental).

Notes / concerns:
- 16% effective discount is slightly above our standard 2yr prepay band for this ARR profile; Rafael, do you want to cap at 15% or approve 16% given the credit buffer and optional ramp?
- Contract language: need to be explicit that credit buffer expires and cannot be carried into renewals. Legal will push for that.
- Billing: finance prefers semi-annual invoices for accounting simplicity; Olg a flagged amortized monthly schedule in workbook — reconcile before term sheet.

My recommendation: approve up to 16% on the condition we make the credit buffer non-transferable and require the customer to elect the ramp true-up in writing at month 11 (so we have time to provision). Also keep the invoice cadence to semi-annual to limit AR complexity.

Ben Carter
Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

From: olga.petrov@redwood.com
To: Asha Raman <asha.r@lumenix.com>
Cc: procurement@lumenix.com, ben.carter@redwood.com, rafael.mendes@redwood.com, neha.kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 16:23:00 -0800
Subject: Final: Approved structure and DocuSign for signature

Hi Asha — thanks for the patience while we routed approvals. Internal sign-off summary: we can offer the smoothed 24-month prepay with the following firm terms: 1) effective 16% discount when amortized monthly across 24 months; 2) 3% credit buffer for year-2 overages (expires at contract end, non-transferable); 3) optional one-way true-up at month 12 on incremental volume at an 8% incremental discount; 4) invoice cadence: semi-annual (first invoice due at contract start, second invoice at month 7).

Operational notes:
- If Lumenix elects the month-12 true-up, please provide confirmation by day 330 of the agreement (we will prepare a simple amendment form).
- Credit buffer usage will be shown as a line-item credit on the next regular invoice; any excess usage beyond credit buffer is billed at the contracted overage rate.
- We will include the amortization schedule as an appendix to the SOW.

Next steps: I've attached the redline-ready term summary and started a DocuSign envelope to formalize. Please review and sign if acceptable. If Lumenix prefers an annual prepay invoice rather than semi-annual, we can discuss but it will change the effective discount (Finance flagged a ~40bps impact).

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/sign/XYZ-PLACEHOLDER
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/67890

Thanks again — looking forward to getting this across the finish line before Thanksgiving.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0192
[Attachment: term_summary_redwood_v2.pdf (pdf); Lumenix_prepay_workbook_v3.xlsx (xlsx)]
